messages:
Leah (Partnerships): Quick sync  piloting a tighter SI co-sell handoff for marketplace leads next week. want to lock ROE here.
Omar (SI): high level?
Leah (Partnerships): new flow: marketplace leads enter a 36h "alignment window" instead of immediate first-claim. during window Sales + SI reconcile account mapping. after window, if SI has confirmed claim -> lock to SI. otherwise Sales retains.
Maya (Sales): 36h is ok. ask: fast-path if customer explicitly requests partner intro same day?
Ravi (Sales Ops): we can add an "expedite" flag on intake; that'll bypass window. need SFDC fields: handoff_state, claim_by, claim_ts, expedite_flag, si_relationship_flag, staging_deadline.
Omar (SI): also propose: if SI has existing ACV relationship flag in our partner CRM -> instant claim. avoids blocking existing partnerships.
Leah (Partnerships): agreed. rules: 1) si_rel=true -> immediate assign. 2) expedite=true OR customer_message contains "partner intro" -> immediate assign. 3) else -> assign to alignment queue with 36h deadline. add 24h no-contact buffer after claim to avoid concurrent outreach.
Maya (Sales): for dedupe use canonical domain + parent_company link. if ambiguous, auto-schedule a short 15m coordination meeting between Sales rep + SI contact.
Omar (SI): good idea. also want a single-click confirm email so SI can accept ownership w/o SFDC clicks. reduces friction.
Ravi (Sales Ops): opsbot pseudocode for implementation:
```
if si_relationship_flag or expedite_flag:
  owner = si_owner
else:
  owner = alignment_queue
  staging_deadline = now + 36h
```
Leah (Partnerships): communication: we'll publish a one-pager for partners and an internal quick checklist. metrics: measure time-to-claim, % expedited, and % post-handoff conflicts.
leadbot: new lead MKT-9001 created (origin: cloud-marketplace). metadata: account=Veridian Labs, region=EMEA, tags=[marketplace, hw-partner], si_relationship_flag=false
Maya (Sales): edge-case: subsidiary domains like veridian.co.uk vs veridian-group.com. will send two examples to Ravi.
Omar (SI): we'll run two dry-run leads this week: one normal, one expedite. report back by Fri.
Ravi (Sales Ops): will add the fields to SFDC sandbox and wire opsbot. also add an alignment_queue view "Marketplace alignment".
Leah (Partnerships): timeline: run pilot Mon -> Mon+14d evaluation. if clean, enable for Q3 marketplace intake. I'll draft ROE + partner-facing note and drop here for sign-off by EOD Tue.
Maya (Sales): thanks 44D
Omar (SI): thanks all.
